case.title: Orbit Chain bridge, Ethereum vault, 31 Dec 2023
case.coverage: Tokens only (USDT, USDC, DAI, WBTC). Native ETH (~9,500 ETH stolen) is not tracked, so $59.8M of the reported ~$81.5M is covered.
case.notes: Compromised multisig keys (7 of 10). First theft: 10M DAI at 2023-12-31 21:07:59 UTC.

price_note: Stablecoins at $1; WBTC at the Chainlink BTC/USD answer at block 18908000. Native ETH is not included (not visible in token logs).
